data.name: Pintukumar
data.gender_notes: Pintukumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pintu means Lord Vishnu and Kumar is a suffix denoting a young boy. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is commonly used in Hindu communities. The name Pintukumar carries the meaning “Lord Vishnu” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Pintukumar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord vishnu and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name signifies a deep connection to the divine and a strong belief in the power of Vishnu to protect and guide the individual.
data.etymology: Pintukumar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Vishnu.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pintukumar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Pintukumar carries a profound cultural significance in the Hindu tradition. The name Pintu refers to the preserver and sustainer deity, Lord Vishnu, and imparts a sense of divine protection, safety, and strength to the individual bearing the name. Kumar, or young boy, represents the childlike innocence and purity of a devotee, emphasizing the importance of spiritual growth and development.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Pintukumar signifies a deep connection to Lord Vishnu and his divine qualities of love, compassion, and preservation. It is believed that those who bear this name are blessed with the protection and guidance of Lord Vishnu throughout their lives, and are nurtured with the qualities of wisdom, maturity, and strength in order to grow spiritually. By carrying the name Pintukumar, an individual is constantly reminded of their divine connection to God and is encouraged to lead a virtuous and spiritual life, imbued with the qualities of devotion, humility, and selflessness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Pintu Kumar signifies the embodiment of purity and knowledge. Pintu represents the pure heart and mind, while Kumar signifies youth and learning. Together, they symbolize the pursuit of knowledge with a pure heart.
